Gulsara leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about ducks in a row. Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces."
